title: Round-finding machine construction
statement: For a positive integer $m$, types $A$ and $\Gamma$, a transition function $\delta:A\to(\mathrm{Option}\,\Gamma)\to A$, an initial element $a_0\in A$, and a Boolean-valued function $\mathrm{acc}:A\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, the round-finding construction defines a deterministic Turing machine with two work tapes, alphabet $\Gamma$, and states drawn from a phase together with phase-dependent control data. Its initial state is the read phase with control value none.
